atomi.contenuto: Prompt integrale 'SKILLS Level 3 - Turn thick skills into a skill tree': 'Look through my skills folder (.claude/skills) and find my thick skills - any skill where one SKILL.md file is doing all the work (roughly 150+ lines or several different jobs mixed into one file). Before restructuring anything, ask me these in one batch: 1) Which skills do I actually use most weeks? 2) Are any skills off-limits? 3) How aggressive should the split be? Then restructure each thick skill into a skill tree: SKILL.md becomes a short router (lists, when it triggers, table pointing to the right file for each job); each distinct job/reference/template moves into its own file (references/, templates/, or plain .md); the router tells the agent to read ONLY the file that matches the task. Rules: do not change what any skill does, only how it is organized; keep every trigger and rule; a good split makes SKILL.md shorter, not longer; show before/after line counts.'
